game.name: Call of Duty : Modern Warfare 3 (France)
game.desc: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 is an Xbox 360 FPS set against the backdrop of a hypothetical World War III. A direct sequel to the previous two games, the campaign takes us to the four corners of the world to confront the Russians. From Manhattan to London to Paris, the game offers a series of combat situations and is staged in the style of the great Hollywood war films. The game also features a full multiplayer mode as well as a co-op mode.
